description: Get the hosting on a domain (product, plan, status, trial, expiry, auto-renew), or null if there is none. For Secure Static Hosting, deploy_site publishes files once it is ACTIVE. For a Cloud for WordPress site: to change its content (pages, posts, images, settings), use wordpress_request and wordpress_upload_media; `wordpress.site` adds the PHP version and the versions available, the WordPress version setting, SSL, storage used, search visibility, any staging copy, and recent background jobs (`operations`, e.g. a restore in progress).
name: get_hosting
title: Get Hosting
